pumping_head.rule: head = static depth to water + drawdown + pivot pressure (pivots only)
pumping_head.detail: Pumping electricity per field = pumped water x rho g x head / pump wire-to-water efficiency (pump_wire_to_water_eff), as in the national run. Head = pumping_lift_m (static depth to water, Buraidah 2006; equal to the national run's Qassim lift, lift_m.Qassim of data/national/official_2024.json, at every level, or the run stops) + drawdown_m + pivot_pressure_head_m on centre pivots that are not palm groves (model/params.json), all at the same level (low, central, high). Pivot-shaped palm groves get no pivot pressure: palm groves are not sprinkler pivots (as in the national run, whose pivot retrofit scenario leaves them out too).
pumping_head.pivot_rule: centre pivot = circularity above 0.75 and at least 10 ha (model/national_supply.is_pivot; the rule of scripts/s2_fields.py's is_pivot column); pivot pressure goes to centre pivots that are not palm groves, since palm groves are not sprinkler pivots (model/national_supply.pressure_pivots)

notes.depth_age: This box's depth to water (pumping_lift_m) was measured at Buraidah in 2006. At a decline of  0.5-2 m a year (Buscarlet et al. 2024 (Al Ula, Saq-Disi system; cited by Salem & Yihdego 2026, Discover Geoscience 4:203, ref 46), used as an analogue: no measured decline at Buraidah after 2006 was found) the water would be 10-40 m deeper by 2026, which would add 31-123 GWh a year (+8% to +32%) to the central pumping electricity; this is in no total
notes.national_lift_table_age: National lift table (all regions, national figures): The depths were measured between 1979 and 2009 (Hail undated). Water levels have fallen since, by about 1-4 m a year where measured, so today's lifts are probably deeper. Static depth is about 87% of the pumping head used here, so adding the measured declines would raise pumping electricity by roughly 16-25%

depth_age_sensitivity.rule: extra head = decline rate x 20 years (2006-2026) on every field's pumped water, electricity = water x rho g x extra head / pump_wire_to_water_eff at each level; share = that electricity over the radar-only elec_kwh at the same level; [slow, fast] decline
depth_age_sensitivity.decline_source: Buscarlet et al. 2024 (Al Ula, Saq-Disi system; cited by Salem & Yihdego 2026, Discover Geoscience 4:203, ref 46), used as an analogue: no measured decline at Buraidah after 2006 was found

palm_grove_pivots.rule: pivot-shaped palm groves (is_pivot, class palm_grove) get no pivot pressure; pressure_elec_kwh_not_charged is what the pivot pressure head would add on their water (in no total)

pumping_head.components_rule: the electricity split by head component (the three add up to elec_kwh, up to the rounding of each field's electricity); pivot_fields, pivot_ha and pivot_share_of_pumped_water count the pivots that carry pivot pressure (pivot_rule: palm groves left out); mean_head_m and pivot_share_of_pumped_water are weighted by pumped water

classification_range.rule: Both desert thresholds (out/background.json, unrounded) shifted by -1 dB (looser: more fields active) and +1 dB (stricter: fewer) on the stored per-field seasonal peak HV above the desert median; the same palm, class and accounting rules as the radar-only totals (including the pumping head: head = static depth to water + drawdown + pivot pressure (pivots only)), at the same low/central/high factors. Shifting by 0 dB reproduces the published flags.
classification_range.corners_rule: low = minimum over {-1 dB, published, +1 dB} of the low-factor total; high = maximum of the high-factor total

s2_filled.rule: Radar + Sentinel-2 tier, published next to the radar-only totals and never replacing them; the area it adds is measured by Sentinel-2, not by the radar. Classes and flows come from model/national_supply.s2_tier itself, run on the deep dive's own Sentinel-2 flags: green = the field's median seasonal-maximum NDVI above 0.40 (s2_winter_active over 1 Nov-31 Jan, s2_summer_active over 15 Jun-31 Oct; the national flags use 1 Nov-15 Mar and 10 Jun-31 Oct, so this winter window misses wheat that greens only in February-March). (a) Winter fill: a field the radar calls not farmed in either season (radar idle) that Sentinel-2 sees green in winter and not green in summer counts as winter-farmed. Fields the radar sees farmed in summer are not filled. (b) Season fill and (c) Sentinel-2-only fields fill nothing here: the radar observed both seasons on every deep field. (d) A filled field farmed in both seasons gets the year-round (perennial) depth only if the national spring check marks it perennial (not brown over 20 Apr-5 Jun) and Sentinel-2 sees it green in both windows; otherwise it is a rotation (winter plus summer depth). Palm groves among the filled fields: tree cover of 30% or more, farmed in every known season and not brown in spring; radar palm groves are never refilled. (e) Wheat straw on fields that are wheat-pattern only through Sentinel-2 is credited at the national run's straw factor for the field's administrative region (out/national_summary.json s2_filled.caps.by_region, Qassim), so the deep tier follows the national cap: the national cap (GASTAT 2024 wheat area minus the national radar wheat) goes first to the region's national fills (a)/(b), then to its fill (c), pro rata by area; straw_factor_seasons applies here to fills (a) and (b), straw_factor_s2_only to (c). The cap from the box's own radar wheat is kept as a diagnostic only. Water, energy and CO2 are not capped; energy uses the same pumping head as the radar-only totals. Checks (the run stops and writes nothing): the national function keeps the radar class of every field it does not fill, and its flows equal this module's on the same classes within one rounding unit; the cap entry's wheat areas equal those of data/national/fields_national.csv (the same national run), and the national flags were made from that table (its md5 in data/fields/national_flags.json).

radar_plus_s2_seasons.scope: all 4,029 deep-dive fields: radar classes with the winter fill (a); fills (b) and (c) do not occur here

s2_only_fields.scope: only the fields of fill (c), classified from Sentinel-2 alone: none in the deep dive (every field has radar values in both seasons)

combined.scope: all 4,029 deep-dive fields with every fill; equal to radar_plus_s2_seasons, as fill (c) is empty

caps.rule: per administrative region, the national run's straw factors (out/national_summary.json s2_filled.caps.by_region, as published to 4 decimals; 'national' is that entry for the whole region): national cap = max(0, GASTAT 2024 wheat area - the national radar wheat-pattern area (winter-only + rotation)), shared pro rata over the national Sentinel-2-filled wheat-pattern area, first fills (a)/(b) (straw_factor_seasons), then Sentinel-2-only fields (straw_factor_s2_only). The deep dive's Sentinel-2-filled wheat-pattern area is credited with straw at those factors (credited_ha_*). Checked against data/national/fields_national.csv, the table the national flags came from

box_only_diagnostic.rule: not applied: the cap model/national_supply.s2_tier computes on the deep table alone, GASTAT 2024 wheat of the whole region minus the deep dive's radar wheat-pattern area; the box is a small part of the region, so this cap barely binds

winter_fill.rule: radar idle only: winter and summer observed and not active; Sentinel-2 green over 1 Nov-31 Jan and not over 15 Jun-31 Oct

palm_spring_check.rule: filled fields become palm groves only if not brown in spring; these fields met the other palm conditions but are brown in spring

filled_two_season.note: filled fields farmed in both seasons: year-round (perennial) depth where the spring check marks them perennial and Sentinel-2 sees them green in both windows, rotation depth otherwise; year_round_extra_water_m3_over_rotation is what the perennial depth adds over treating every one of them as a rotation

fills.not_applicable: season_fill and s2_only are empty: the radar observed both seasons on every deep field

vs_official.rule: each administrative region's tier totals against GASTAT 2024 wheat and fodder (year-round fields) and MEWA 2024 agricultural groundwater for the whole region; the deep-dive box covers a small part of it. wheat_ha is the uncapped wheat pattern; *_wheat_credited_ha is the area credited with straw after the cap. Water: [low, central, high]
